name: Ordeal of Iron
body:
School conjuration (creation) [earth]; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area cylinder (40-ft. radius, 20 ft. high)
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A rain of iron shards and bands rain down in the area dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage and 1d6 slashing damage to every creature in the area. This damage only occurs once, when the spell is cast. Any creature that takes damage from the spell must make a Reflex save or be bound by the iron and entangled. A DC 18 Strength check or escape artist can free the creature from the iron.

For the remaining duration of the spell, the shards and other iron debris covers the ground, making the entire area difficult terrain and deals 1d4 slashing damage to any creature moving more than 5 feet through the area.

At the end of the duration, the iron debris disappears, leaving no further aftereffects.
